DOUBTS AND CONSERVATIVE READINGS

D1 hasPasswordReset is optional (absent means the client reset route) because ClientShellRoot.tsx is outside this lane. fd-client-shell (shells/client/**) can set it explicitly or move the path into the port.

D2 The client shell no longer subscribes to eligibility at the top. Eligibility is now read only by Home, Profile, the fund page, the verify screens and the invest guard, so it is no longer warmed on sign-in for screens that do not read it.

D3 React Query v5 puts a query with no data back to pending on refetch. A manual Try again therefore shows 'Checking...' until the answer, not the failure with a busy button, so InlineReadFailure's 'retrying' prop is effectively unused in EmailVerificationStatus and InvestingStatus. This is bounded, not a loop. InvestingStatus is cp-profile's (features/profile/**), so the two were left alike.
D4 On the parked invest routes, RequireEligible still shows 'Restoring your session' while a no-data eligibility read is retried. guards.tsx is not owned and the routes are parked.
D5 ClientFrame builds its own resolver instance over the same manifest as ClientShellRoot's hardware resolver. FD-1 (fd-header) can share one.
